purpose: First separate US county yield experiment; retrospective research, not operational approval

labels.source: USDA NASS official Quick Stats bulk

split.spatial_holdout: excluded from every model/preprocessing fit and hyperparameter selection
split.label_lag_status: conservative year rule, not evidence of historical publication or revision availability

weather.support: US Census county internal point; not crop-area weighted
weather.available_at: unknown for historical vintages; retrospective only

calendars.status: fixed regional hypotheses; no observed planting dates or crop phenology claims

features.weather: three equal pre-cutoff segments: rain sum, Tmin/Tmax/RH/wind/radiation mean, hot days Tmax>32C, freezing days Tmin<0C, dry days rain<1mm, maximum dry run; plus year and coordinates

candidates.selection_metric: county-balanced validation MAE over non-held-out counties

freeze: save models, scalers, feature columns, candidate choices, protocol/code/input hashes and target-free test predictions before any test label evaluation; verify hashes; score once with exclusive creation

evaluation.primary: candidate chosen in validation vs every baseline; no new winner selected from test
evaluation.secondary: frozen best of each model family, exploratory
metrics: MAE divided by mean observed yield
evaluation.bootstrap: paired county-cluster bootstrap; limited to the three observed test years
evaluation.research_confirmation: at least 5 percent MAE gain over every baseline, county-cluster upper confidence bound below zero with Bonferroni family control over 5 scopes x 4 baselines, no negative gain on spatial holdout, at least 30 county-harvest pairs in both temporal and spatial sets

exposures: Source-discovery search snippets displayed some Iowa 2023/2024 yields and two Iowa 2025 yield values before this protocol. No model scores or US trained-model predictions were inspected. This is documented partial prior label exposure; do not call the holdout fully blind.
Current revised USDA/POWER snapshots do not establish point-in-time availability. No operational claim from this experiment.
promotion: No modification to BR serving catalog or prospective registry; US artifacts remain research-only even if retrospective gates pass
